description: Returns the workspace members as { id, firstName, lastName, email, roleId, status } per user. Optional: searchTerm (matches firstName/lastName), filters, sortDescriptor, page, pageSize. Each id is the user id of that member (the userId of a team member update and an assignedUserIds value on records); roleId is the id of a role in the workspace role catalog.

filters.description: Array of filter rules, AND-combined. Each rule is { field, operator, value? }. Use only the operators listed in each field's hint; value-less operators take no value. Example: [{"field":"createdAt","operator":"inLastDays","value":30}]. Filterable fields: status (one of: active, inactive, pendingAuthorization; operators: in, notIn), createdAt (ISO date string; operators: gt, gte, lt, lte, between, inLastDays, notInLastDays), updatedAt (ISO date string; operators: gt, gte, lt, lte, between, inLastDays, notInLastDays).

pageSize.description: Results per page, any whole number from 1 to 100, served exactly: page 2 of pageSize 50 holds records 51 to 100. When a result was truncated, ask again with about half the size. Default 25.

searchTerm.description: Free-text search against firstName and lastName

sortDescriptor.description: Sort by one field: { field, direction: "asc" | "desc" }. Sortable fields: name, createdAt, updatedAt.

name: list_users

page.description: The page returned, counted in pageSize

pageSize.description: The page size asked for; every page but the last holds exactly this many records

title: List users
